verdict.rationale: vLLM ships its own OpenAI-compatible HTTP API server, started from the CLI, plus an official Docker image for deploying it. That is a network-facing service other devices can call. Anthropic Messages API and gRPC endpoints are also documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of binding to a LAN interface (host/port options) or of access and authentication controls for remote clients, and independent hands-on reports of serving to other devices on a local network.
